summary: All 15 are in their clubs' predicted XIs in the Premier League's MW11 line-ups, but no second permitted outlet has published XIs yet, so every verdict is likely. Worries: Konsa (Saliba is ready to start), and Boscagli and Tavernier are one booking from a ban; Neto is predicted as Chelsea's striker with Joao Pedro out.
